Viewer help

Valid cells

Valid stored — cells with a finite value after recorded processing, divided by all cells in the stored archive rectangle at the stated grid spacing. Values may be measured, derived or interpolated. Missing or invalid count metadata is shown as unknown.

Valid shown — its count and spacing follow the current shown detail. In Smooth mode, it counts finite layer and terrain samples. In Cells mode, it counts finite averaged blocks with a finite terrain sample at the corresponding grid position. Both use all grid positions as the denominator. Zero is valid, including a mask's zero state.

Cells averages valid exported values within each block at the selected resolution. A partly missing block can still have an average, so its validity may be higher than Smooth's sampled validity. Empty blocks stay blank. Smooth changes detail by sampling; it does not average new blocks.

These counts are not visible screen pixels, viewport clipping or triangle counts. Temporary comparisons have no stored archive dataset; their shown count follows the selected result and colour mode.

Valid display in Details counts finite cells in the exported display grid before terrain mapping or rendering detail. Export block averaging can make this percentage higher than stored validity without adding measurements; edge cropping and product-specific reductions can also change it.

These counts describe data availability, not measurement quality or the fraction passing a coherence cutoff.

Alignment & value conversion

B = raw × scale + offset. Centre sampling is not area averaging; A is an exported block-mean preview. Categorical and circular products use nearest sampling.

Exploratory comparison, not native-resolution validation. Website values are quantized; some layers are clipped. Only shared valid cells enter the difference and statistics.

Flat PNG preview

3D & PNG colours

Colours only: tails saturate at the selected limits. No samples are removed and statistics stay unchanged. A/B share a colour range. Symmetric mode expands percentile bounds to ± the larger magnitude. The 0–1 mask preview uses fixed state colours; percentile and zero controls are disabled.

PNG map pixels match the analysis grid, independent of zoom or terrain detail. White/transparent cells contain no shared data. PNG follows the comparison's colours and range, including edits in the existing 3D legend, without terrain lighting.

What the calculation means

Linear products: Δ = B − A. Aspect: Δ = ((B − A + 180) mod 360) − 180 degrees. Wrapped phase: the same shortest signed difference with π and 2π. Masks: Average compares the original passing fractions. The 0–1 preview applies A's selected cutoff to both original fractions, then subtracts the states (−1 = lost pass, 0 = unchanged, +1 = gained pass). A fraction at or above the cutoff passes; missing blocks stay blank. Change A's mask preview controls in the terrain legend to update both inputs.

Mean = ΣΔ/n; MAE = Σ|Δ|/n; RMSE = √(ΣΔ²/n). These describe disagreement, not accuracy unless A is appropriate ground truth. No vertical-datum conversion is performed. Scientific metadata, timestamps, and acquisition compatibility still need review.
